t: Ingest rate measurement — Archive Growth Analyzer
title: Ingest rate measurement — Archive Growth Analyzer
description:
The archive growth analyzer measures how the archive actually grows: rates per collection, distributions across topics and sources, bursts and droughts. Where the forecaster looks forward, the analyzer looks closely at now — giving curators the facts behind 'the archive is growing fast' and the early warnings when growth stalls or explodes in one corner. Every number it reports is traceable to counted records.

This record documents the ingest rate measurement approach: Count records per hour/day per collection with rolling averages that smooth without hiding.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.

Every record in this database is the full fully-formed file with all data — never a stub or description alone. This database holds 15 of the 1,000,000 target — the march to a million is in progress.
demo:
# Archive Growth Analyzer demo: rates, burst and drought detection.
import statistics
daily={"news":[120,131,118,400,125,122,0,119],"papers":[40,42,39,41,38,43,40,41]}
for name,series in daily.items():
    mu=statistics.mean(series); sd=statistics.pstdev(series) or 1
    bursts=[(i,v) for i,v in enumerate(series) if v>mu+3*sd]
    droughts=[(i,v) for i,v in enumerate(series) if v<mu-3*sd]
    print(name,"avg/day=%.1f"%mu,"bursts:",bursts or "none","droughts:",droughts or "none")
